text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"No need to beat yourself up over it, Vodka!
After all, your opponent was me..."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: To an already flawless, perfect running style, the "Overlord-style Training" was added—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Because right now, I have evolved even further
and reached even greater heights...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. The Trainer over there
conceived it specifically for me.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: It suits this body remarkably well, and my radiance is only continuing to grow!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Woah!
Just changing the menu makes that big of a difference?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Guidance from a dedicated Trainer really is something else, huh...
choice_data_list: Though it's all thanks to hard work.
Though it's all thanks to hard work.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Indeed... Your strength was cultivated through worshiping me day after day—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I haven't just grown myself,
I've spurred on Trainer's growth as well!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: “Ah! How magnificent, yet how terrifying I truly am...!!”

It doesn't quite feel like praise,
but in her own way, T.M. Opera O seems
to acknowledge the coaching.
